avoidWhen.text: Avoid for failed commands; use error-recovery instead.

customize.text: Present as an inline banner near the affected data or a warning toast (such as Loam's loam-toast with tone warning).

keep.text: Exposes the warning inside a status, alert, or named region carrying its warning text.
Provides a named, keyboard-focusable dismiss control when warnings are dismissible.
Fits a narrow viewport without horizontal overflow.
Convey warning tone with a word or icon in addition to color so forced-colors and color-blind users still read it.

default.text: Mount a warning from spec/wire/result-success-full.json (or Loam's loam-toast with tone warning) exposing the warning notice and a named Dismiss button.

summary: Surface non-blocking result warnings with text tone indicators and a named dismiss control without relying on color alone.

useWhen.text: Use when a succeeding command returns one or more entries in result.warnings.
